A great night in Quang Binh
Dec 2019 • Family
One of the best hotel we have ever been. Great view of the river for a duluxe double room for us and a twin room fpr our kids. The rooms are superbly new, spacious and well-maintained. The hotel is right at the riverbank with some steps away from a local market. We did have a great walk to visit it both early morning and enjoy the sunset at the sand dune which is 7 kms away. 

But the thing I love the most is the breakfast. Even though it is in the low season, we are offered a fully selective buffet breakfast with great varieties from local food to international common cusine, small but sufficient. I love the staff working there as well. They are so nice, friendly and helpful, esp Ngoc, Loan and Hoa. I love their smiles. 

Overall, I love my stay here, just one night but it makes my day.

Huong P
Dear Ms. Rachaell797
Thank you for taking the time to feed back for our restaurant. We take a great concern referring to your negative experience, our food and service did not meet your expectations. As the F&B Manager of Vinpearl Hotel Quảng Bình, I would like to sincerely apologize for the negative experience you had at Nhật Lệ Restaurant. Having read your comment, I am appalled by the treatment you experienced. This does not reflect the high standards we hold at the Nhật Lệ Restaurant.
In your feed back, The Salmon was over cooked, the vegetables were cold and the portion sizes were very small. This meal was very very expensive by Vietnamese standards.
We are sorry to have inconvenienced you on your visit to Quang Binh. Your complaint has inspired us to re – train the staffs. Now, all employees have been reminded that the appropriate procedure in this situation.
Please accept our most sincere apologies. Given the unfortunate experience you had here at the Vinpearl Hotel Quang Binh.
Thank you again for sharing your experience, and we hope that your next stay with us will be better meet our standard of excellence

Sincerely,
